title: Issuer Services
text:
Issuer Services
Euronext Securities Milan offers "tailor-made" services to help Issuers with complex transactions.
Our services include:
Support for M​&A operations
Global Coordinator in Public Tender Offers (OPA/OPS) in Italy
Support for all non-standard market transactions.
Covered Warrants & Certificates - Paying agent and 871m services
Dual or multiple listing
Ferretti Group Dual Listing Case Study
Euronext Securities helps Ferretti Group achieve dual listing in Europe and Asia
We can povide a unique cross model to help Issuers access a wider range of international markets.
Read the Case Study
New Data Service for Issuers
Euronext Securities Milan's HOLDINGS REPORT
The service provides clients with enhanced transparency and control over their issuances and investor base.
